caption: Brendan might be like Barney in How I Met Your Mother. Wish I'd taken like, two steps back.
Fog clearing in the late morning. Pretty neat to be above the clouds.
Cooked this one. Start of the Sureshot's light leak, I think.

For context, Brendans and Ben were out here for an annual camping shindig. We camped at the base of Elbert and Massive and did them on back-to-back days. I don't know if it was then, or someone Madi told me about, but I guess there were a couple dudes running up 'em back-to-back days for like, weeks. Pretty jealous.

Back when we were below the clouds. Man, nothing's in chronological order here. I think we did Elbert day one and Massive day two. Day one was pretty misty and foggy and gave some of those sick photos above the inversion (not sure that applies when it's scattered clouds but whatever).
And the second day was pretty sunny, but the wind at the top was absolutely WHIPPIN'. Good time for Pringles.
There's an iconic photo of Brendan with about 45 cans of Pringles. Better than anything on this page.
No power pose from Brendan. Poor staging by me.
Just so cool to look down when you're above the treeline.
